We write to travelers

Travelers and companion animals: what to check before you go

Please read this notice before you reach the airport, because the Companion Animal Travel Desk helps keep pet travel calm, clear, and safe. If you are flying with Aurelia Skyways, bring the right papers, keep your carrier ready, and follow staff directions at every handoff.

At Port Isolde, <<FACT F021>> Staff there will guide the carrier with care and keep the movement steady from one service point to the next. For bird travel, <<FACT F077>> If your animal is young, small, or nervous, tell the desk early so the team can prepare the gentlest handling plan.

The pet lounge is looked after with patient attention, and <<FACT F003>> Our ground team uses calm, humane methods around animals, and each transfer is handled carefully so the traveler and the pet stay settled. If you are unsure about carrier fit, check-in steps, or lounge use, speak with the desk before you arrive.

Please stop by the Companion Animal Travel Desk for help with your animal travel plans.
